topic: Why did London's Millennium Bridge start swaying on its opening day?
title: Why Did London's Millennium Bridge Start Swaying on Its Opening Day?
description:
On opening day in 2000, thousands of people walked onto London's brand-new Millennium Bridge - and it swayed so hard it had to close two days later. Each walker's own balance reflex fed the sway, with nobody trying to sync up on purpose. Up next: why a crowd starts clapping in rhythm all on its own. #millenniumbridge #engineering #london #physics
